symbols.name: guard width
symbols.meaning: The number of extra fractional and integer bits reserved per real component, which bounds the depth of every value.
symbols.quote: The guard-width bound reserves an explicit count $\Delta$ of extra fractional and integer bits per real component

symbols.name: first input value
symbols.meaning: The first of the two values that the two-point map combines.
symbols.quote: The two-point map $H_0$ sends values $u,v$ to $((u+v)/2,(u-v)/2)$.

symbols.name: second input value
symbols.meaning: The second of the two values that the two-point map combines.
symbols.quote: The two-point map $H_0$ sends values $u,v$ to $((u+v)/2,(u-v)/2)$.

symbols.name: axis bound
symbols.meaning: A bound on the number D of selected bits in a layer, so that D is at most d.
symbols.quote: Here $d$ is a bound on the number $D$ of selected bits, so $1\le D\le d$.

symbols.name: depth
symbols.meaning: The number of operations on a chain that follows an operand from an input into a value.
symbols.quote: Let $\ell$ be the depth of a value, the number of operations on a chain that follows an operand from an input into it.

symbols.name: splitting factor
symbols.meaning: The factor by which a call divides the axis count.
symbols.quote: Each call divides the axis count by $m$, the splitting factor.

symbols.name: group size
symbols.meaning: The number of selected axes in a group that the recursion splits.
symbols.quote: A group of $e$ selected axes splits into $s$ calls on groups of $e/m$ axes.

symbols.name: depth bound
symbols.meaning: The bound on the number of operations on any chain within a group, as a function of its size.
symbols.quote: Let $A(e)$ bound the operations on any chain within such a group

symbols.name: gate budget
symbols.meaning: The most gate operations charged at a node of the recursion.
symbols.quote: let $E=64(W+m+1)^3$ be the most gate operations charged at a node

symbols.name: internal levels
symbols.meaning: The number of internal levels of the recursion.

symbols.name: level factor
symbols.meaning: The growth factor $s+E$ that each recursion level multiplies a bound by.
symbols.quote: Put $B=s+E$, so each level multiplies a bound of at least $1$ by $B$

symbols.name: real bound
symbols.meaning: A real number at least one, used as a generic bound in the level inequality.

symbols.name: exponent
symbols.meaning: The least positive integer $j$ with $m^j\ge B$.
symbols.quote: Let $\nu$ be the least $j\ge1$ with $m^j\ge B$

symbols.name: shift count
symbols.meaning: The number of places a shift moves, equal to $\lfloor D/2\rfloor$.
symbols.quote: the shift is by $t=\lfloor D/2\rfloor$ places

symbols.name: floor
symbols.meaning: The largest integer not exceeding its argument.
symbols.quote: $\lfloor x\rfloor$ is the largest integer not exceeding $x$

symbols.name: depth constant
symbols.meaning: The constant $128mB^2$ in the depth bound $C_0d^{C_1}$.
